utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still collecting tools and folks can drop by after lunch if they want to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and I heard they could use extra hands sorting donations too, so it might be worth swinging by if you’ve got a bit of time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. Just let me know when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll let you know when I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look now. What’s the issue with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s dragging and making a nasty grinding sound when I try to use it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds like the bearings or gears may be shot. I’ll take a quick look and see if it needs cleaning or replacement.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few things on the list: a loose hinge, a cracked step, and one outlet cover that still needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the hinge and outlet cover, and I’ll look at the cracked step too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help organize a time around the school schedule, but I need to know what kind of repair drive you mean.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I mean a neighborhood repair drive for things like fixing small household stuff, bikes, and basic furniture. I can give you the full list and we can pick a time that works around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds useful. Send me the list and I’ll help find a time that fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll stick to the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The roof by the back porch, I think. I keep meaning to say it before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: All right, then the roof by the back porch goes first. I’ll put it at the top of the list and keep us on that track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, if you can help with the repair drive, I’ll send word around right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know the timing and where the repairs are happening first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday morning at the corner houses on Maple, and I’ll send you the exact block list right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I only got that second-hand. What are they needing most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mostly small appliance fixes, clothes mending, and a few bikes. If you’ve got tools or a steady hand, that’s what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help with tools or mending; I just need to know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what’s already been decided for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’ve agreed on the repair drive itself, but I don’t have the details pinned down yet. I’ll share the exact plan as soon as it’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repairs, but I need to keep things quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I’ll keep it quiet and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I’ll keep it quiet and just let me know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill and a few spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That would help. Can you bring the screws too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I’ll bring the screws too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the route in mind. Tell me where you want me to check first, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start at the front gate and work inward. I want the wiring and the broken latch checked first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’ll check the wiring first, then the broken latch at the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got my tools ready if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if the drive gives me trouble.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — just give me a shout if it acts up, and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we need to make sure the parts and timing are lined up first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the parts are actually available and the timing still works on your end?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I still want a quick confirmation on the parts list and the timing window before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that drive, Mara. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll point the right people your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules. I still need someone to take tools to the East Block and another person to check which homes need the late-afternoon run.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask two folks: one for the East Block tool run, and one to check which homes need the late-afternoon pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a small stash of nails and tape set aside if the repair drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring some extra screws and a screwdriver if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then I’ll pull together the rest of the small stuff and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam again. Folks are saying they're looking for a few more volunteers before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do that after I check our schedule, but I’d be glad to help if they still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good to hear. I’ll let them know you might be available once you’ve checked your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll keep you posted on the next steps for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, thanks. Just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the battery and the cables. If those look good, I want the alternator next.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it. I’ll check the battery and cables first, then move on to the alternator if they look fine.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell — I can put you on the list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll wait for the update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, Nell. I’ll send the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, I can keep track of that. Where is the repair drive taking place?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s at the community hall on Maple Street. I’ll be there after breakfast, around nine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, the community hall on Maple Street around nine after breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When do you need me there, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Tomorrow at 9, and please bring gloves, a flashlight, and any basic tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll be there at 9 with gloves, a flashlight, and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting moving, which is good. I can check around and see who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good, good, that helps. I should probably check my notes and see who I was going to call first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with that. I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know who still needs a call.
